src/main/java/DownloadFormat.java: public enum DownloadFormat { MP4, WEBM; public static DownloadFormat fromExtension(String ext); public String defaultExtension(); } Semantics: fromExtension maps 'mp4' and 'webm' (case-insensitive) to respective enum constants; throws IllegalArgumentException for unknown or null/empty ext. defaultExtension returns '.mp4' for MP4 and '.webm' for WEBM.

src/main/java/ValidationUtils.java: public final class ValidationUtils { public static boolean isValidUrl(String url); public static String sanitizeName(String name); public static String withExtension(String baseName, DownloadFormat format); } Semantics: isValidUrl returns true only for non-null URLs with scheme http or https, at least one '.', and no spaces; does not perform network I/O. sanitizeName trims, replaces any sequence of non-alphanumeric ('a'-'z','A'-'Z','0'-'9'), dash, underscore, or dot with a single underscore, collapses spaces to underscores, and ensures non-empty result (returns 'download' if sanitized becomes empty). withExtension appends format.defaultExtension() to sanitized baseName, ensuring baseName does not already end with that extension; throws IllegalArgumentException if format is null.

src/main/java/VideoDownloadRequest.java: public final class VideoDownloadRequest { private final String url; private final DownloadFormat format; private final String suggestedName; private final String outputName; public static VideoDownloadRequest of(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName); public String getUrl(); public DownloadFormat getFormat(); public String getSuggestedName(); public String getOutputName(); } Semantics: of validates inputs: url must pass ValidationUtils.isValidUrl; format and suggestedName must be non-null; outputName computed as ValidationUtils.withExtension(ValidationUtils.sanitizeName(suggestedName), format). src/main/java/DownloadStatus.java: public enum DownloadStatus { PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED; } Semantics: State machine statuses; transitions governed by DownloadTask as described below.

src/main/java/ProgressListener.java: public interface ProgressListener { void onProgress(long downloaded, long total); void onCompleted(); void onFailed(String message); } Semantics: callback boundaries; implementations must be non-blocking and avoid throwing exceptions.

src/main/java/TransferSession.java: public interface TransferSession { boolean step(); void cancel(); long getTotalBytes(); long getDownloadedBytes(); } Semantics: step advances exactly one deterministic transfer chunk, returns true if more steps remain after the step; returns false when no more steps; cancel stops the session and leaves it in a terminal state with downloaded <= total; total and downloaded are non-negative.

src/main/java/TransferAdapter.java: public interface TransferAdapter { TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener); } Semantics: begin starts a new deterministic session. May throw IllegalArgumentException on invalid arguments; must not perform network I/O in this project.

src/main/java/OfflineDeterministicAdapter.java: public final class OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter { public TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener); } Semantics: begin validates non-null args and returns a deterministic TransferSession with: totalBytes = 1000; per-step increments of 100 until reaching totalBytes; on each step it invokes listener.onProgress(downloaded, total); when downloaded == total it invokes listener.onCompleted(); cancel() stops further step(); step() after completion returns false always; step() after cancel returns false; listener.onFailed is not used in this deterministic implementation. Guarantees headless, offline operation.

src/main/java/DownloadTask.java: public final class DownloadTask { private final int id; private final VideoDownloadRequest request; private DownloadStatus status; private TransferSession session; private int progress; public DownloadTask(int id, VideoDownloadRequest request); public int getId(); public DownloadStatus getStatus(); public int getProgress(); public String getOutputName(); public void start(TransferAdapter adapter); public void tick(); public void cancel(); } Semantics: Constructor initializes status = PENDING, progress = 0. start(adapter) requires current status == PENDING; creates a ProgressListener that updates 'progress' as (int) Math.round(100.0 * downloaded / total) clamped 0..100, sets status to RUNNING, and wires session via adapter.begin(). tick(): if status == RUNNING and session != null, calls session.step(); recomputes progress; if session reports no more steps and progress == 100, sets status = COMPLETED; tick() when CANCELLED or COMPLETED or FAILED is a no-op. cancel(): if status is RUNNING or PENDING, cancels session (if non-null) and sets status to CANCELLED; idempotent if already terminal. Error behavior: IllegalStateException if start() called when not PENDING.

src/main/java/VideoDownloader.java: public final class VideoDownloader { private final TransferAdapter adapter; private final java.util.Map<Integer, DownloadTask> tasks; private int nextId; public VideoDownloader(TransferAdapter adapter); public int requestDownload(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName); public void startPending(); public void tick(); public void cancel(int taskId); public DownloadStatus getStatus(int taskId); public int getProgress(int taskId); public String getOutputName(int taskId); } Semantics: Constructor requires non-null adapter. requestDownload creates VideoDownloadRequest.of and a new DownloadTask with id = nextId++, stores it, returns id. startPending starts all tasks with status PENDING. tick advances all RUNNING tasks by calling DownloadTask.tick(). cancel looks up task by id and calls task.cancel(); throws IllegalArgumentException if id unknown. getStatus/getProgress/getOutputName return properties for existing tasks; each throws IllegalArgumentException if id unknown.
